title: Neutrino Test-Realization Artifact
description: The test-realization companion artifact (M5 WP2, ): the concrete backend test cases folded ONCE from a capability spec + a scenario, emitted by `neutrino-gen --target=test-realization`. It lives OUTSIDE the capability hash scope — it carries `capabilityHash` as a REFERENCE to the capability it realizes, and is never hashed into it, so changing only a scenario/test never changes the capabilityHash. Every migrated backend renderer (Solidity/Foundry, PostgreSQL) consumes this fold rather than re-deriving from the raw scenario. Deterministic + canonical (sorted keys, no timestamps). Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false). See docs/testing/TEST_REALIZATION.md.

capabilityHash.description: The capability these cases realize — a reference to the spec's identity.capabilityHash, NOT this file's own identity. This file is outside the hash it points at.

scenario.description: the scenario name these cases come from

inputs.description: concrete input values, keyed by input name (integer or string per the input's value type)

computed.description: expected value of each compute, keyed by compute name (integer minor units)

eventChain.description: the expected coordination event order (must equal the IR-derived choreography; validated at fold time)

ledgerDeltas.description: expected net movement per ledger, keyed by ledger name (signed integer minor units)
